No published procedure volume was found, so none is recorded.

The surname Datla is distinctive; the only same-name hit anywhere was a Wikipedia article on 'Datla Satyanarayana Raju', a historical Andhra figure, which is plainly a different person and was ignored. BAND MEDIUM: yashodahospitals.com is the ONLY official source. Its several page families (doctor page, branch roster, department listing, best-doctors landing pages) are all one domain and per the rules count once. Skedoc is corroborating-only.
